evidence.text: In [StakingManager::stake()](https://github.com/code-423n4/2025-04-kinetiq/blob/7f29c917c09341672e73be2f7917edf920ea2adb/src/StakingManager.sol#L230-L237), the staking limit calculation includes rewards but ignores slashing events when determining available capacity:

The calculation only subtracts `totalClaimed` from `totalStaked + rewardsAmount` but does not consider slashing events. When validators are slashed, the actual staked amount decreases, which should increase available capacity. By not accounting for slashing, the staking limit remains artificially lower than it should be.

links.reported_relation: The staking limit calculation ignores slashing, so actual staked amount falls below the limit yet the stake is rejected.
